name: Dragon Lords (Yakuza Gang)
body:
Yakuza who belong to this gang care only for their own, working with their fellows to ensure that their allies are the only ones who succeed.

Edict: The yakuza must protect their own, doing their best to make sure they only trade and do business amongst their own ranks. Against outsiders, they must give no favors, instead doing their best to get the better of any dealings with such people. The yakuza’s customs, secrets, and other information must be kept from outsiders at all costs, never giving out such information willingly.

Sneak Attack: A dragon lord yakuza selects 1 creature type from the ranger’s favored enemy list; they gain a +2 competence bonus to attack rolls against foes with this creature type whenever they would make an attack that qualifies for sneak attack damage.

Skills: Whenever a dragon lord yakuza uses Bluff against a non-dragon lord yakuza, they receive a bonus on the check equal to 1/3 their yakuza level (minimum +1).

Gang Abilities: A yakuza belonging to this gang gains the following abilities as they increases in level:

Superb Loyalty (Ex)

At 2nd level, a dragon lord yakuza can use the aid another action as a swift action. If the dragon lord yakuza is adjacent to a foe, that foe takes a -1 penalty to the next attack roll or saving throw they make until the end of their next turn.

Dynamic Teamwork (Ex)

At 8th level, a dragon lord yakuza knows how to best maximize their ability to aid their allies. Once per day when they use the aid another action to assist an ally, that ally also gains an additional move action that they can take on their turn. At 12th level and every four levels afterwards, a yakuza can grant an additional move action per day.

Perfect Sync (Ex)

At 15th level, whenever a dragon lord yakuza grants an ally an additional move action, they can spend two uses of their dynamic teamwork ability to instead grant them an additional standard action.
